label: assertion
text: (a) mask-based localization editing using a selected subset below 0.5% of all weights can effectively modify stereotypical gender bias
完整表述: When using the subnetworks and localization masks to apply the local editing primitives (weight interpolation, weight extrapolation, pruning, mask switch) to a BERT-base-uncased target model with a reference of opposite gender-bias polarity (one stereotypical, one anti-stereotypical), mask-based localization editing using a selected subset below 0.5% of all weights can effectively modify stereotypical gender bias as measured by the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs.
